releases.notes:
## What's Changed
* Migrate to official faststats metrics with small common compatibility layer by @Adammatthiesen in https://github.com/Matthiesen-dev/matthiesen-core/pull/67
* Refactor and organize code, moving some logic from the Core to the API package scope by @Adammatthiesen in https://github.com/Matthiesen-dev/matthiesen-core/pull/68
* Implement Discord webhook notification system with client and notifier instances by @Adammatthiesen in https://github.com/Matthiesen-dev/matthiesen-core/pull/69
* Refactor event observables and improve package structure by @Adammatthiesen in https://github.com/Matthiesen-dev/matthiesen-core/pull/70
* Update Gradle configurations and dependencies for NeoForge compatibility by @Adammatthiesen in https://github.com/Matthiesen-dev/matthiesen-core/pull/71
* Add fabricloader dependency for compatibility with newer versions by @Adammatthiesen in https://github.com/Matthiesen-dev/matthiesen-core/pull/72
* Update NeoForge version to 21.1.234 in configuration files by @Adammatthiesen in https://github.com/Matthiesen-dev/matthiesen-core/pull/73
* Update README for Fabric and NeoForge version compatibility by @Adammatthiesen in https://github.com/Matthiesen-dev/matthiesen-core/pull/75
* Add PLAYER_BLOCK_BREAK event for server-side block break actions by @Adammatthiesen in https://github.com/Matthiesen-dev/matthiesen-core/pull/76
* Add method for generating mod-specific configuration file paths by @Adammatthiesen in https://github.com/Matthiesen-dev/matthiesen-core/pull/77
* Enhance BuiltInEconomyProviders with type and availability checks by @Adammatthiesen in https://github.com/Matthiesen-dev/matthiesen-core/pull/78
* Add ChatColors enum for simplified chat color management in utilities by @Adammatthiesen in https://github.com/Matthiesen-dev/matthiesen-core/pull/79
* Refactor ChatColors enum for color codes and retrieval enhancement by @Adammatthiesen in https://github.com/Matthiesen-dev/matthiesen-core/pull/80
* Enhance error logging in AdventureTextParser and clean up imports by @Adammatthiesen in https://github.com/Matthiesen-dev/matthiesen-core/pull/81
* Refactor text parser to use singletons and add ModdedTextParser interface by @Adammatthiesen in https://github.com/Matthiesen-dev/matthiesen-core/pull/82
* Refactor economy and networking management for better clarity by @Adammatthiesen in https://github.com/Matthiesen-dev/matthiesen-core/pull/83
* Refactor mixin configuration for better organization and clarity by @Adammatthiesen in https://github.com/Matthiesen-dev/matthiesen-core/pull/84
* Implement LuckPerms permission validator and enhance environment checks by @Adammatthiesen in https://github.com/Matthiesen-dev/matthiesen-core/pull/85
* Refactor player data management and migrate to PlayerRecordDataV2 by @Adammatthiesen in https://github.com/Matthiesen-dev/matthiesen-core/pull/86
* Refactor configuration management and add translatable titles by @Adammatthiesen in https://github.com/Matthiesen-dev/matthiesen-core/pull/87
* Refactor package structure for improved organization by @Adammatthiesen in https://github.com/Matthiesen-dev/matthiesen-core/pull/88
* Refactor exception handling and improve package structure for webhooks by @Adammatthiesen in https://github.com/Matthiesen-dev/matthiesen-core/pull/89

## Breaking Changes

- `v1` and `v2` of Matthiesen Core are **NOT** compatible, please wait to update the core mod till the mods that use it update to support v2
- New minimum versions
  - Fabric: Requires `0.18.4+`
  - NeoForge: Requires `21.1.234+`
- No longer Supported:
  - Matthiesen Core webhooks: Functionality has been merged into Matthiesen Core.
- Faststats is no longer shadowed, it's now packaged as a jar-in-jar.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Matthiesen-dev/matthiesen-core/compare/v1.3.5...v2.0.0
